scope: Deepen the open-source DWG/DXF comparison by separating field decoding, geometric transformation, unknown-object layout, performance, and downstream-consumer evidence; reconcile only with existing plan owners.

method.kind: Read-only primary-source web research plus local plan/source inspection
localInspection: DWG_DXF_OPEN_SOURCE_PARITY_PLAN.md: PAR-06 PERSUBENTMGR policy, PAR-21/7H coordinate-frame/analytic geometry owner, PAR-92/7BA/7S.3 performance work and existing peer reports
src/drw_entities.cpp: DRW_Arc and DRW_Ellipse DXF/DWG field parsing and arbitrary-axis helpers
src/drw_objects.h and src/libdxfrw.cpp: bounded opaque-object and class-tail handling
Current source, plan state, and worktree status were inspected only; no tests or peer tools were run
method.evidenceRule: Peer issues, mutable source, releases, and author measurements are route- and revision-specific. They generate bounded local questions but are not format authority, local defect reproductions, or independent semantic support evidence.

evidence.topic: ACadSharp entity transform as a geometric-oracle limitation
evidence.observed: Issue #1250 reports wrong transformed ARC endpoints and an ELLIPSE rotation discrepancy. The latest formal release page lists signed v3.8.0 at 3a1c66b without a transform fix in its release notes; mutable current Arc.ApplyTransform still maps endpoint vectors via Matrix3 multiplication. No current package/runtime test was run.
doesNotEstablish: that the issue reproduces in ACadSharp v3.8.0 or current master
that libdxfrw serializes ARC or ELLIPSE fields incorrectly
that ACadSharp cannot be used for typed field or record comparison
evidence.planUse: Keep PAR-21/7H analytic OCS/world calculations as the geometric oracle. Pin and calibrate a future ACadSharp transform route before scoring its derived geometry; preserve parsed fields and transformed geometry as separate observations.

evidence.observed: Issue #1398 reports an ambiguous PERSUBENTMGR field sequence and a peer trace that reads an implausible num_subents value. The reporter explicitly corrects the thread: the earlier merged PR concerned ASSOCPERSSUBENTMANAGER, not PERSUBENTMGR.
doesNotEstablish: a local libdxfrw defect or valid libdxfrw dispatch number
that the peer issue is fixed by the distinct ASSOCPERSSUBENTMANAGER PR
evidence.planUse: Preserve PAR-06's opaque/unsupported status. Require authoritative layout and versioned producer evidence before typed implementation; never hardcode the peer's reported type code.

evidence.observed: Open PR #1402 describes three distinct quadratic paths in LibreDWG and reports author-run improvements and output comparisons. The PR remains open/undeployed and has a cla_needed label; its timings and tests were not reproduced in this task.
doesNotEstablish: that peer handle-first ordering preserves libdxfrw source-order semantics
portable wall-time thresholds for local CI
evidence.planUse: Reuse PAR-92/7BA/7S.3's existing deterministic work counters and perform any scale experiment at the scheduled composed checkpoint only after a corresponding local hot path changes.

evidence.topic: LibreDWG DXF writer edge cases and local policy boundary
evidence.observed: The issue bundles a zero-valued HATCH coordinate rejection, unusual attribute-tag loss, and embedded-MTEXT field rejection. These are separate peer reports; its proposed tolerant handling is not a universal DXF policy.
doesNotEstablish: that arbitrary unknown groups should be ignored in all entity scopes
that omission of a required embedded-object scope marker preserves semantics
evidence.planUse: Keep value presence, tag profiles, embedded-MTEXT scope, and following-record alignment under their existing owners; add no broad unknown-group skip or duplicate regression.
